meta.title: Gamini Sri Sanjeev — Upanayanam
meta.description: Join us in celebrating the Upanayanam of Gamini Sri Sanjeev — the sacred second birth.

hero.name: Gamini Sri Sanjeev
hero.subtitle: celebrates his Upanayanam
hero.body: Join our family as Sanjeev receives the sacred thread — a quiet, joyful morning of mantra, fire, and blessings.
hero.imageAlt: Family gathered around the sacred fire for Upanayanam

ceremony.title: Not only a ceremony — a beginning
ceremony.intro: For the Gamini family, Sanjeev’s Upanayanam is a morning we have looked forward to with quiet excitement. We hope you will sit with us, offer a blessing, and share the meal that follows.

pillars.title: The sacred thread
pillars.body: The yajnopavita is worn across the shoulder as a reminder of duty — to learn sincerely, live with restraint, and care for others. Three strands speak of debt to teachers, ancestors, and the divine.

pillars.title: Gayatri mantra
pillars.body: Sanjeev will be initiated into the Gayatri — a prayer for clear mind and steady light. It is less a ritual to finish, and more a companion for the years ahead.

pillars.title: A second birth
pillars.body: Upanayanam is often called the second birth because it marks a child’s formal step into learning and responsibility, guided by family, guru, and community.

timeline.title: A simple plan for the day
timeline.intro: Times are approximate after the muhurtham — rituals move with the priest’s pace and the joy of the moment. Arriving a little early helps.

events.title: Welcome & Ganapathi Puja
events.detail: Guests arrive, settle in, and we begin with prayers to Lord Ganesha for a smooth and auspicious start.

events.title: Muhurtham — Yajnopavita Dharana
events.detail: The heart of the morning: Sanjeev receives the sacred thread with family around the homa fire.

events.title: Gayatri Upadesham
events.detail: Initiation into the Gayatri mantra — a quiet, intimate moment of teaching and blessing.

events.title: Aashirvadam & lunch
events.detail: Elders offer blessings, photographs, and then we share a festive meal together. Please stay if you can.

venue.title: When & where
venue.intro: We would love to have you with us for the muhurtham and the meal that follows. Tap below for directions on your phone.

blessings.title: Kindly RSVP
blessings.intro: A short note helps us welcome you with care — seating, lunch, and the morning’s flow. Whether you can join in person or send blessings from afar, we would love to hear from you.
blessings.tip2: Tell us if elders or little ones are joining
blessings.tip3: Note any dietary needs in the form

footer.name: Gamini Sri Sanjeev
footer.note: With love from the Gamini family. Thank you for walking with us on this sacred morning.
